requirements.summary: Coordinates processes across the building blocks into workflows
requirements.statement: It MUST enable the coordination and integration of processes across the various building blocks, allowing the creation of more sophisticated and end-to-end automation workflows.

requirements.summary: Runs workflows from events, synchronous, asynchronous or scheduled
requirements.statement: Process execution SHOULD follow an event-driven approach, where events can be received synchronously, asynchronously, or generated on a scheduled basis.

requirements.summary: Supports compensating actions for a controlled rollback
requirements.statement: Execution logic SHOULD allow for reverse/compensating actions when a step results in an error or unexpected result, allowing for a controlled rollback. This may be hard to implement due to network infrastructure limitations.

requirements.summary: Offers a dry run of a workflow
requirements.statement: It SHOULD provide a dry-run operation to check the expected result of the workflow without actually executing it.

requirements.summary: Schedules workflows on a regular basis or at a set time
requirements.statement: It SHOULD provide the ability to schedule the execution of a workflow on a regular basis or at a given time in the future.

requirements.summary: Gives logging and traceability of past and current workflows
requirements.statement: It SHOULD provide end users with an understanding of the whole automation logging and traceability in the past and current workflows.

requirements.summary: Correlates events to decide the course of action
requirements.statement: It MAY include logic to correlate multiple events, infer relationships, and determine the appropriate course of action based on the event context.

claims.description: Nautobot stores the intended state of a network in extensible data models and runs automation jobs against that data, with REST and GraphQL APIs and an app framework.
claims.claim_note: Jobs run on demand or on a schedule and webhooks connect other tools, but coordinating automation in response to events is a secondary feature, not the main purpose.

claims.description: Platform where infrastructure teams build workflows and AI agents that call existing tools such as Ansible, Python and OpenTofu, and run network changes with access control, approvals and audit logs.
claims.claim_note: Coordinating automation tasks across existing tools, triggered by people, workflows or agents, is the product's main purpose.

claims.description: Network and IT infrastructure automation software with prebuilt integrations for third-party products that have an API or CLI, used to provision resources and manage configuration and traffic.
claims.claim_note: The source describes orchestration across platforms and a workflow engine, but gives no detail on event-driven execution, so the extent is partial.

claims.description: Platform that runs and coordinates infrastructure-as-code workflows for Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Kubernetes and Ansible, with policies, approvals and drift detection.
claims.claim_note: Coordinating and triggering infrastructure-as-code and configuration runs is the product's main purpose.

claims.claim: The Apache Software Foundation Apache Airflow - Orchestrator
claims.product: The Apache Software Foundation Apache Airflow
claims.description: Platform for writing workflows as Python code and for scheduling and monitoring them.
claims.claim_note: Coordinating and running tasks on schedules and in response to external events is the main purpose of Airflow; it is a general-purpose engine and ships no network-specific tasks.

claims.description: Platform for building and running scripts, workflows, internal apps and data pipelines, with schedules, webhooks and generated user interfaces.
claims.claim_note: Running flows on schedules and from webhook events is the main purpose of Windmill; it is a general-purpose engine and ships no network-specific tasks.

claims.description: Durable execution platform that runs application code as workflows, records each step and resumes workflows after failures.
claims.claim_note: The opened pages support coordinating and running workflow steps reliably, but they do not describe starting workflows in response to events, and Temporal ships no network-specific tasks.

claims.description: Data orchestration platform that defines pipelines around the data assets they produce and tracks their lineage, quality and dependencies.
claims.claim_note: Coordinating pipeline runs on schedules and in response to events is the main purpose of Dagster; it is a general-purpose data tool and ships no network-specific tasks.

claims.description: Workflow orchestration platform that runs Python workflows with scheduling, retries, caching and recovery.
claims.claim_note: Coordinating workflow runs on schedules and in response to events is the main purpose of Prefect; it is a general-purpose engine and ships no network-specific tasks.

claims.description: Network security policy management suite that analyzes firewall, cloud and SASE policies against a defined zone policy and automates access change requests.
claims.claim_note: The suite coordinates the steps of an access change request, which covers only security-policy changes rather than all network automation tasks.
